title: GET a JSON document
summary: Send GET requests for small JSON documents to a local HTTP/1.1 server over keep-alive connections, eight in flight at a time, and parse each response.
notes: The server is a scripted program in its own process, the same for every entry; its work is not counted. An entry keeps its connections open and reuses them; the server counts them. Only the client's process is measured: time spent waiting for the server is not CPU time.
